title: Four-query circuit PCPP system
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $n>0$ input bits. The four-query circuit PCPP system has Boolean alphabet, input length $n$, proof length equal to the circuit’s quadratic PCPP proof length, and verifier given by the circuit’s four-query function tester.
